option_relations.rationale: The option describes a specific type of HUS precipitated by pancreatitis, which is not directly related to Thrombotic Thrombocytopenic Purpura (TTP).
The option describes a specific type of thrombotic microangiopathy associated with pancreatitis, which is not directly related to Thrombotic Thrombocytopenic Purpura (TTP).
Hemolytic Uremic Syndrome (HUS) is a distinct thrombotic microangiopathy from Thrombotic Thrombocytopenic Purpura (TTP).
Atypical Hemolytic Uremic Syndrome (aHUS) is a distinct thrombotic microangiopathy from Thrombotic Thrombocytopenic Purpura (TTP).
